311:t_1:15.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「...I understand. Everything shall be as you wish...」

311:t_1:20.en:
$$レモン$$
「...That man $$リック$$ who was murdered was your team's pilot, wasn't he!?」

311:t_1:22.en:
$$レモン$$
「What are you going to do!? Who's going to compete in tomorrow's match!?」

311:t_1:23.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I know that without you telling me!」

311:t_1:25.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...I'm sorry, too... But this really hit me hard...」

311:t_1:26.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Maybe this makes a good story for a reporter like you, Mr. $$レモン$$, but...」

311:t_1:27.en:
$$レモン$$
「...It's true I came to cover the AS arena here in $$ナムサク$$.」

311:t_1:28.en:
$$レモン$$
「I admit a bloody incident there makes a perfect story. But that doesn't mean I'll turn a blind eye to murder.」

311:t_1:30.en:
$$レモン$$
「We've known each other for two whole days, and you only just noticed?」

311:t_1:31.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...I think the $$オーガ一家$$ killed $$リック$$.」

311:t_1:32.en:
$$レモン$$
「They're the people secretly running this town?」

311:t_1:33.en:
$$ナミ$$
「And they're backing the team we're fighting tomorrow.」

311:t_1:34.en:
$$レモン$$
「Then they did that to $$リック$$... to keep you from winning...!」

311:t_1:35.en:
$$ナミ$$
「They seem to have thought we were a nuisance all along.」

311:t_1:36.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...I'll pilot the AS in tomorrow's match.」

311:t_1:37.en:
$$レモン$$
「Have you ever competed in an AS arena?」

311:t_1:38.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I'm the team owner and mechanic. I've never competed, but I know how to operate it.」

311:t_1:39.en:
$$レモン$$
「That's crazy! They'll even kill to win! They'll kill you, too!」

311:t_1:40.en:
$$ナミ$$
「But I have to compete and win...!」

311:t_1:42.en:
???
「...Is there a man named $$リック$$ here?」

311:t_1:44.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm an acquaintance of his. We were in a mercenary unit during the civil war about three years ago.」

311:t_1:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's a problem. I was hoping to use his connections to become a pilot in this AS arena...」

311:t_1:47.en:
$$宗介$$
「How about hiring me for your team? I guarantee I'll do at least as well as $$リック$$.」

311:t_1:52.en:
$$ナミ$$
「There are plenty of idiots your age pretending they're ace AS pilots.」

311:t_1:53.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Those machines aren't invincible anime robots or super robots filled with humanity's dreams.」

311:t_1:54.en:
$$ナミ$$
「They're precision machines. They were originally specialized military equipment.」

311:t_1:55.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Fight in one, and you'll be covered in bruises. Most people get sick and puke everywhere. Sprains and broken bones are normal.」

311:t_1:56.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Half-assed amateurs can't handle them. If you get it, go home, you deluded little...」

311:t_1:57.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's an $$Ｒｋ－９１$$... You're using a fine machine.」

311:t_1:59.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's an early model of the machine known as the $$サベージ$$. It's heavier and less powerful than the current $$Ｒｋ－９２$$.」

311:t_1:60.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's because it lacks a gas turbine engine, but its frame is stronger than the 92's. It's still decent in close combat.」

311:t_1:62.en:
$$宗介$$
「Its problem is cooling. But for short matches, buy a new $$マッスルパッケージ|lc$$ for explosive power instead of improving the cooling system.」

311:t_1:63.en:
$$ナミ$$
「D-don't act like you know everything!」

311:t_1:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「But you've worked hard to maintain it. It's amazing just to have an early 91 model still operating.」

311:t_1:65.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Y-you're just a weapons nerd who's filled his head with facts, aren't you? Act smug all you like, an amateur is still...」

311:t_1:69.en:
$$レモン$$
「I-I don't really understand, but... he knows a lot about this. In that case...」

311:t_1:70.en:
$$ナミ$$
「All right. ...But this arena is no joke... I can't guarantee you'll survive.」

311:t_1:73.en:
$$レモン$$
「I'm $$ミシェル・レモン$$... I'm a journalist, but things just happened, and I've become something like this team's sponsor.」

311:t_1:74.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I'm $$ナミ$$... I'm the team owner.」

311:t_1:75.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm... $$相良宗介$$. I came here looking for something.」

311:t_1:76.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wait for me, $$千鳥$$... Even on my own, I'll find you. I promise...)

311:t_10:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「You've surprised me, $$ＡＧ$$. I never thought you'd bring the whole $$Ｄトレーダー$$ setup aboard, as well as arranging a transport ship.」

311:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please, praise me more, $$カレン$$. This $$Ｄトレーダー$$ and $$Ｚクリスタル$$ are a dimensional merchant's life, after all.」

311:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even in the chaos of that $$時空震動$$, I risked my life to keep them safe.」

311:t_10:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's admirable, $$ＡＧ$$. I really respect you now, risking your life like that for your business.」

311:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$カレン$$, your anger while fighting $$カン・ユー$$ produced 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

311:t_10:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「You really love $$Ｚチップ$$s, don't you?」

311:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I certainly do...! I'll do anything to earn $$Ｚチップ$$s!」

311:t_10:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll help, too. ...Though I don't know what I should do...」

311:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, in that case, please change into this bunny suit.」

311:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I, $$ＡＧ$$, thought this might happen, so even amid the $$時空震動$$ chaos, I brought out this treasured suit.」

311:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come now, $$カレン$$! Don't be shy. Please put it on right away.」

311:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you excite $n and $$クルツ$$ with it, the $$Ｚチップ$$s alone will come pouring...」

311:t_10:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「What do you mean, you risked your life!? You had time to bring that out! You had plenty of room to spare!!」

311:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How can you call it that...!? This suit is a masterpiece, tailored to follow your body perfectly, $$カレン$$!」

311:t_10:18.en:
$$カレン$$
「When the hell did you make that!?」

311:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! I'm so glad you're safe!」

311:t_10:24.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. I'm happy to see you again, too.」

311:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... I'd been getting a fair amount of information about you and your companion, Miss $$スズネ$$.」
